prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the clinical picture seen in this type of crash. Over the course of twelve visits, the patient received a structured program of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and a home exercise plan, which followed a typical course for a cervical strain. Treatment intensity was reduced gradually as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation were documented and support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflex testing, and motor strength were within normal limits. The patient reports a prior mild strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records show two similar charges entered on the same day, which are currently under review for accuracy. Overall prognosis is good, with expected full recovery and discharge from active care.
